result.title: Nonreciprocal Spherical Attention and Retrieval: Sharp Coarsening Clocks and Certified Score Correction
result.comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables. Includes mathematical appendices and ancillary reproducibility code
result.summary: We develop nonreciprocal spherical attention as a mathematical framework for coarsening and compressed nearest-neighbor retrieval. For two shrinking acute blocks whose centers have zero skew pairing and whose total mass ratio is subexponential in inverse temperature, we prove $\lim_{β\to\infty}β^{-1}\log T_β=1-\cosφ$, without restricting particle-count growth. An explicit three-body flow has two rigorously separated metastable exponents. For finite compression, mass centering yields a sharp $O(r^2)$ attention-output error bound at fixed temperature, with an explicit spherical-normalization correction. We formulate skew query-side score calibration as a strictly convex moment problem and derive a unique normal equation, residual-based optimization certificates, and bounded low-rank projections. A norm-aware margin objective calibrates native squared-distance rankings. Experiments use semantic retrieval data, one million visual descriptors with three codebook seeds, and a ten-million-vector FAISS IVF-PQ index with recomputed exact cosine ground truth. On SIFT1M, skew margin calibration raises native-L2 hit@10 from 0.8926 to 0.8948; symmetric calibration reaches 0.8996. The ten-million-vector index reaches 0.8827 hit@10 at 0.1794 ms per query in a four-thread batch benchmark, while validation selects no skew update. Exact streamed attention over ten million keys evaluates compressed memory on 1,024 held-out queries. Independent matrix solves, automatic differentiation, finite differences, interval arithmetic, full-flow tests, and nine Rocq-checked algebra lemmas support reproducibility. Directionality alone does not establish retrieval superiority.

AI.brief_summary: 提出非互易球面 attention 的数学框架：证明粗化速率极限，给出有限压缩下 attention 输出的 O(r^2) 误差界与球面归一化校正，并将偏斜打分校准构造为严格凸矩问题，在 SIFT1M、百万视觉描述子和千万级 FAISS IVF-PQ 检索上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 压缩 attention 的输出误差界与偏斜打分校准，可能为 latent 状态压缩后相似度检索和视觉证据筛选的偏差修正提供可供核查的线索，但该文面向检索与统计力学，未涉及 VLM 推理。
